'''Yannick Lapointe TYPE-II The Solution''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19015">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19015 TYPE-II The Solution], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 20 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19015/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19015/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017021625/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19015/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 20 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''TYPE-II The Solution''

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif|label=My Lord, Is That Legal?}}

== Original post ==
